title: Nigel Farage Ethics Probe Resumes After UK Election Victory
title_cn: 英国大选胜利后奈杰尔·法拉奇道德调查恢复
summary: Nigel Farage is returning to Parliament after comfortably defeating a satirical candidate dressed as a trash can, in an election victory which allowed an ethics probe to resume into the Reform UK leader’s personal finances.

title: US Presses Allies on Ideological Loyalty Ahead of Troop Cuts
title_cn: 美国在削减军队之前向盟友施压，要求其意识形态忠诚
summary: The US wants to know how loyal each NATO ally is to Donald Trump’s policies before cutting military assets defending the alliance.
